tasks.label: 🟢 START EVERYTHING (Rick + Hive Mind + Dashboard)
tasks.detail: 🔥 SMART STARTUP: Detects running services, graceful reuse, 7-phase boot with verification

tasks.label: 🪄 Left Pane → Live Narration Follow
tasks.detail: Switch the left pane to a live, plain-English narration stream

tasks.label: 🖥️ Left Pane → Full Monitor
tasks.detail: Restore the left pane to the full monitor (status + narration + positions)

tasks.label: 👥 Agents: Show (Top-Right)
tasks.detail: Show grouped agents list in the top-right pane

tasks.label: 🙈 Agents: Hide (Top-Right)
tasks.detail: Hide agents list in the top-right pane

tasks.label: 📎 Attach to Dashboard (tmux)
args: tmux attach -t rbotzilla-dashboard || echo 'Dashboard is not running. Run: 🎮 OPEN DASHBOARD ONLY'
tasks.detail: Attach your terminal to the running 3-pane tmux dashboard

tasks.label: 📜 View Narration Log
tasks.detail: Live narration stream (plain English summaries; no JSON, no code)

tasks.label: � RLP: tmux Narration + ML Filter
args: cd ${workspaceFolder} && chmod +x scripts/tmux_narration_ml_side.sh scripts/stream_ml_filter.sh 2>/dev/null || true && scripts/tmux_narration_ml_side.sh
tasks.detail: Open a tmux session with left=pretty narration, right=ML filtered events

tasks.label: �🧠 START Hive Consensus Updater
tasks.detail: Continuously writes config/hive_consensus.json based on practice momentum

tasks.label: 📡 START Shared Pricing Cache
tasks.detail: Updates data/pricing.json for all agents to read (unified source)

tasks.label: 🎮 OPEN DASHBOARD ONLY (Rick + Hive already running)
tasks.detail: Open 3-pane tmux dashboard (assumes Rick/Hive/Engine already running in background)

tasks.label: 🤖 START Rick LLM (Ollama) - Always Running
tasks.detail: Start Ollama server for Rick narration - keeps running in background

tasks.label: 🐝 START Hive Mind (Trading Engine) - Always Running
tasks.detail: Start OANDA trading engine with Hive Mind decision-making - keeps running

tasks.label: 📊 MONITOR: Live Narration + Positions (Left Pane)
tasks.detail: Display live narration stream, active positions, Charter parameters

tasks.label: 🧠 MONITOR: AI Decision Filtering (Top-Right Pane)
tasks.detail: Watch Momentum → Smart Logic → Stop Loss → Hive Mind → Guardian decisions in real-time

tasks.label: 🎮 CONTROL: Manual Command Terminal (Bottom-Right Pane)
tasks.detail: Manual control: start, stop, status, positions, log, help, exit

tasks.label: 🛑 STOP EVERYTHING (Rick + Hive + Dashboard)
args: pkill -f 'ollama|oanda_trading_engine|tmux|python3 dashboard|bash start_dashboard|interactive_command_terminal' && sleep 1 && echo '✅ All systems stopped'
tasks.detail: ❌ EMERGENCY STOP - Kill Rick, Hive Mind, and all dashboard processes

tasks.label: 🔄 RESTART EVERYTHING (Clean kill + fresh start)
args: pkill -9 -f 'ollama|oanda_trading|tmux|python3 dashboard' ; sleep 2 ; cd ${workspaceFolder} && (ollama serve &) && sleep 2 && python3 oanda_trading_engine.py & sleep 1 && bash start_dashboard.sh
tasks.detail: Force kill everything then do fresh ONE-CLICK START of Rick + Hive + Dashboard

tasks.label: 💬 TALK TO RICK: View Narration Stream
tasks.detail: Live narration stream (clean plain English, no JSON keys)

tasks.label: 🐝 HIVE STATUS: Check Trading Engine Status
args: ps aux | grep -E 'oanda_trading|ollama' | grep -v grep && echo '' && echo '✅ Rick (Ollama) and Hive Mind (Trading Engine) are RUNNING'
tasks.detail: Verify Rick and Hive Mind are running

tasks.label: 📈 VIEW: Account Balance & Stats
tasks.detail: Quick check of OANDA practice account status

tasks.label: 🧪 TEST: Verify OANDA Connection
tasks.detail: Test OANDA API connectivity

tasks.label: 📋 LIST: Show All Running Processes
args: echo '=== RUNNING SYSTEMS ===' && ps aux | grep -E 'ollama|oanda_trading|python3.*dashboard|tmux' | grep -v grep || echo 'No systems running'
tasks.detail: Show which systems are currently running

tasks.label: 🔧 SETUP: Make All Scripts Executable
args: cd ${workspaceFolder} && chmod +x start_dashboard.sh dashboard_live_monitor.py ai_decision_monitor.py interactive_command_terminal.sh && echo '✅ All scripts executable'
tasks.detail: Ensure all dashboard scripts have execute permissions

tasks.label: 📚 GUIDE: Show Quick Start Reference
tasks.detail: Display quick start guide

tasks.label: 📊 VIEW: Strategy Aggregator Status
tasks.detail: Plain-English list of strategy availability (5/5, with names)

tasks.label: 📈 VIEW: IBKR Paper Status
tasks.detail: Quick plain-English IBKR paper connection and account summary

tasks.label: � Test IBKR Gateway (Port Check)
tasks.detail: Checks local IB Gateway/TWS API port (paper=4002, live=4001)

tasks.label: � Test IBKR Gateway (Custom Host)
tasks.detail: Probe IB Gateway/TWS on a custom host:port (use Windows host IP if running TWS there)

tasks.label: ��🤖 START OANDA Paper Trading (ONE-CLICK)
tasks.detail: Start OANDA paper trading with Ollama + Hive Mind

tasks.label: 📊 View OANDA Account Balance
tasks.detail: Quick check of OANDA practice account status

tasks.label: 🧪 Test OANDA Connection
tasks.detail: Verify OANDA practice API connectivity

tasks.label: 🛑 Stop All Trading
tasks.detail: Emergency stop - kill all trading processes

tasks.label: 🎯 RLP: Start Non-HFT Paper Runner (MEGA)
tasks.detail: Start autonomous engine with hardened narration (H1 timeframe, PACK_ROUTED/HEDGE/TRADE_BLOCKED events)

tasks.label: 🛑 RLP: Stop Paper Runner
args: cd ${workspaceFolder} && pkill -f autonomous_decision_engine.py && echo '✅ Paper runner stopped' || echo '⚠️  No engine running'
tasks.detail: Stop the autonomous engine paper trading process

tasks.label: 📊 RLP: View Narration Stats
tasks.detail: Show PACK_ROUTED, HEDGE_ON/OFF, TRADE_BLOCKED event counts

tasks.label: ✅ RLP: Validate Narration JSONL
tasks.detail: Validate logs/narration.jsonl structure and required fields

tasks.label: 📦 RLP: Package Support Bundle
tasks.detail: Create support_upload_*/{logs.zip, code_config.zip} with sanitized .env and curated files
